### The Way Up Is Down
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-14-2023.html
Passage: Matthew 20:26-28
Points:
- The mother of James and John asked for places of high status for her sons.
- The other disciples became indignant because they also craved those positions of honor.
- Worldly structures measure greatness by ranks, authority, and exercising control over others.
- Jesus reversed worldly ambition by establishing that kingdom greatness is attained through humble service.

### The Greatness of Service
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/greatness-service
Passage: Matthew 20:27-28
Points:
- The disciples' anger exposed that all of them were secretly competing for recognition and rank.
- Secular leaders operate by asserting power, whereas kingdom values center on serving others.
- Believers reflect Christ's example by setting aside personal rights for another person's benefit.
- Faithful leadership is demonstrated through humble action rather than demanding authority.
